scope: Real sandbox file side-effect path joined to the same H1 cognition/UnifiedDB ledger: proposal -> host capability permit -> persisted intent -> atomic effect -> verified/recovered outcome -> typed UnifiedDB re-entry.
authority_and_effect_invariants: model and peer outputs remain authority NONE
host permit binds capability, sandbox root, current epoch, proposal hash and byte budget
intent is durably represented in the same logical ledger before filesystem mutation
write uses temp-file fsync + atomic replace + directory fsync in the sandbox reference implementation
post-effect file hash is verified before normal COMMITTED_VERIFIED outcome
crash after intent or temp fsync recovers as not applied when preimage remains
crash after atomic replace recovers as committed when target hash equals intended hash
unexpected external target state is RECOVERY_CONFLICT rather than silently accepted
retry of same committed effect is idempotent and does not advance ledger epoch
reusing one effect_id with a different proposal is denied

negative_results.finding: First 100-cycle effect stress produced only 23/100 FullRuntime wrapper audit PASS although all 100 file effects were correctly written and 10/10 after-replace crash cases recovered.
negative_results.cause: Effect outcome re-entry queried the broad effect domain with limit=16. As history grew, lexicographic ordering excluded the just-created effect from the selected window.
negative_results.resolution: Bind the re-entry QuerySpec to keys=(effect_id,) so consequential outcome reconstruction targets the exact causal effect identity rather than an arbitrary bounded prefix.
negative_results.post_fix_result: 100/100 audit PASS under the identical stress structure; 700 events; exact replay hashes.

architecture_implication: Consequential re-entry must be identity-addressed. Generic bounded retrieval is unsafe for causal outcome reconstruction even when it is acceptable for exploratory context assembly.
limitations: Filesystem effect is a sandbox reference effect, not unrestricted host mutation authority.
Power-loss behavior is approximated by injected process crash points and fsync discipline; no physical power-cut test is claimed.
Target Ubuntu filesystem and hardware behavior remain unmeasured in this phase.
